name: NSIC Cross Country Championships
where: Sioux Falls, SD · Yankton Trail Park
headline: NSIC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Augustana won the men’s title with 25 points over Minnesota State (68), and Winona State won the women’s with 45 over Minnesota State (81). Minnesota State’s Luis Pfister (24:09.4) and Winona State’s Stella Rusch (19:51.6) won the individual races.
